Quick answers

Before you install.

What is Xen GFX?

Xen GFX is an Android companion that organizes MLBB hero guides, builds, matchups, preparations, and practice tools.

Does the app refresh its data?

Yes. Core data is refreshed during the splash loading screen so updated content is ready when the main screen opens.

Is Xen GFX an official MLBB app?

No. Xen GFX is an independent, fan-made companion and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Moonton.
